{{Event Infobox
| Name  = The Ssssserpent
| Image = Event-Serpent.png
}} {{Small Card Infobox|Doubt}}
{{E|The Ssssserpent}} is an [[Event]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 1]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Agree}} {{TS|positive||Gain 175}} {{Asc|15|(150)}} {{TS|positive||Gold.}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}} {{C|Doubt}}{{TS|negative||.}}
<br><br>
{{Frame|Disagree}} Nothing happens.
<br><br>
You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You walk into a room to find a large hole in the ground. As you approach the hole, an enormous serpent creature appears from within.
<br>
{{TS||up|"Ho hooo! Hello hello! what have we got here?}} Hello adventurer, I ask a simple question.
<br>
The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can {{TS|gold|up|buy anything!}}
<br>
Do you agree?"
</div>

{{Frame|Agree}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS||up|"Yeeeeeeesssssssssssessss!
<br>
Thissss will all be worthhh it.
<br>
..ssSSs..... ss... sssss....!"}}
</div>

{{Frame|Continue}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The serpent rears its head and blasts a stream of {{TS|gold||gold}} upwards!
<br>
It is amazing and terrifying simultaneously.
<br>
You gather all the {{TS|gold||gold,}} thank the snake, and get going.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Disagree}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The serpent stares at you with a look of extreme disappointment.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* {{R|Ssserpent Head}} from the {{E|Face Trader}} event references this event. There is no special dialogue if the player encounters {{E|The Ssssserpent}} while owning their face.
* The internal name of this event is <code>Liars_Game</code>.
** This is a reference to the manga [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liar_Game ''Liar Game''], as confirmed by one of the developers on Discord<ref>https://ptb.discord.com/channels/309399445785673728/309399445785673728/780191500973375488</ref>.
